name: uxui
description: Measured UI improvement loop: rounds of trial, measure, triage, design decision, build and gate, with hard gates on every merge and lower-is-better ratchets against a baseline.

interface.shortDescription: Improve a web UI in measured rounds that never make a measured value worse.
interface.longDescription: Run rounds of trial, measure, triage, design decision, build and gate on a web UI or docs site: hard gates on every merge (no scroll, always-visible controls, unmissable completion, a screen-only user, axe-core accessibility), every finding turned into a regression test, and lower-is-better ratchets against a committed baseline.json.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the ui-iteration-loop skill to run a measured improvement round on this UI.
